# montecarlo_dremio_credentials (Resource)

Dremio credentials are the access token Monte Carlo stores for Dremio connections to use. The token is never returned.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `host` (String) Hostname of the Dremio Arrow Flight endpoint, such as `data.dremio.cloud` for Dremio Cloud (`data.eu.dremio.cloud` in the EU).
- `port` (Number) Port Dremio serves Arrow Flight on.
- `token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Personal access token Monte Carlo signs in to Dremio with. Stored by Monte Carlo and never returned.
- `token_wo_version` (Number) Bump to send `token_wo` again. Terraform stores this, never the secret.

### Optional

- `db_name` (String) Dremio project or space to connect to.
- `tls` (Boolean) Connect over TLS. Dremio Cloud requires it.

### Read-Only

- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
